name: Core incident handling (always applies)
description: Baseline steps every incident follows, from NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 2 section 3 and the bank's IR policy.

steps.text: Activate the incident response team and open a dedicated war-room channel; assign an Incident Commander and a scribe.
Issue a legal hold so logs, mailboxes and backups relevant to the incident are not deleted by retention policies.
Validate the alert: confirm it is a real incident (not a false positive) and record when the bank first became aware.
Assess functional and information impact; set severity; brief the DPO and Legal if personal data or customer funds may be involved.
Assess whether the incident meets DORA's criteria for a MAJOR ICT-related incident (clients affected, duration, data loss, critical services, economic impact).
Preserve volatile and log evidence BEFORE remediation: hash every evidence file and register it with a custodian.
Hold a lessons-learned review within two weeks; record root cause, what worked, and control improvements.
Finalise the incident report and regulatory follow-ups; retain the sealed timeline per the bank's record-retention policy.
